verses.text: Ur gam sungah pasal khat a teng hi; ama min pen Iyyob ahi hi. Tua mipa pen paubaanna nei loin a thutang khat ahi hi. Amah in Yahweh zahtakin, gitlohna a peel hi.
Amah in tapa sagih leh tanu thum a nei hi.
Ama neihsate pen: tuu 7,000, kalaoh 3,000, bawngtal kap 500, laa anu 500 leh nasem tampitak zong a nei hi. Hih mipa pen nisuahna lama mi khempeuh laka a haupen a suak hi.
A tapate in amau inn ciat ah kikhelin pawi bawl zelzel uh a, amaute tawh a ne khawm a dawn khawm dingin ka sanggam numei teng thum a sam uh hi.

Pawi bawl hunte vial khat a zawh ciangin, Iyyob in amaute sawlin, a kisiansuahsak hi. Zingsang tuungin amah thobaih-in, amaute khat ciat aa dingin biakpiakna pia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Ka tapate mawhin a lungsim uh panin Yahweh samsia kha ding hi,” a ci hi. Iyyob in hih pen ngeina bangin hih den hi.
Ni khat, Yahweh mai-ah Yahweh’ tapate a kilaak dingin a pai ciangin, Satan zong amaute lakah a pai hi.
Yahweh in Satan kiangah, “Koi pana hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Satan in Yahweh kiangah, “Leitung ah kileh kawikawi-in, ka paisuk ka paitohna pana hong pai ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Satan kiangah, “Ka nasempa Iyyob na ngaihsun kha hiam? Leitung ah amah tawh a kibang Yahweh zahtakin gitlohna a peel paubaanna a nei lo, a thutang khat beek omlo hi,” a ci hi.
Satan in Yahweh dawngin, “A thu omlo pi-in Iyyob in Yahweh zahtak ahi hiam?

Nangmah in ama kiimkot ah dai kai-in, ama innkuanpihte leh ama neihsa khempeuh kiimkot ah mun khempeuh ah daikai hilo na hi hiam? Nangmah in ama hahkatna peuhpeuh thupha pia-in, gam sungah ama neihsate na pungsak hi.
Ahih hangin Na khut zanin ama neihsa khempeuh vat lecin, na maitang mahmah ah Nang hong samsia pah ding hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Satan kiangah, “En in, tu-in ama neihsa khempeuh nangma vangliatna sungah om hi; ama tung taktak ah na khut nga kei peuh lecin,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ omna panin Satan a paikhia hi.
Ni khat a tapate leh a tanute in a sanggam upenpa’ inn ah an ne-in, leenggahzu a dawn laitakun,
Iyyob kiangah kamtai khat hong tungin, “Bawngtalte in lokai-in, tua gei-ah laate a gamta uh hi;
tua ciangin Sabe mite in hong do-in tuate a puakhia uh hi. Namsau hiam tawh na nasemte kithat mang a, nang hong gen dingin kei bek ka suakta hi,” ci-in thu a puak hi.
Amah in a gen laitak pi mahin, adang khat hong tungin, “Van panin Yahweh’ meikuang hong kia-in, na tuute leh na nasemte kangtum a, nang hong gen dingin kei bek ka suakta hi,” a ci hi.

Amah in a gen laitak pi mahin, adang khat hong tung a, “Chaldea-te pawl thumin hong kuanin, kalaoh-te hong matsakin, a puakhia mang uh hi. Amaute in namsau tawh na nasemte thatin, nang hong gen dingin kei bek ka suakta hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in a gen laitak pi mahin, adang khat hong tung a, “Na tapate leh na tanute in a sanggam upenpa’ inn ah an ne, zu dawnin a om uh hi;
Sehnel gam kantanin thakhat thu-in huihpi hong nungin, inn kiu li a vatgawp hi. Amaute tungah tua inn puk a, amau teng si-in, nang hong gen dingin kei bek ka suakta hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Iyyob dingto-in, a puantualpi balkek a, tua khit ciangin a lu a kiattol hi. Leilak ah amah puksukin, Yahweh bia a,
tua ciangin amah in, “Ka nu’ gil sung panin guak tangin ka suak a, guak tang mahin ka ciahkik ding hi. Yahweh in hong pia-in, Yahweh in lakhia mang hi. Yahweh’ Min kiphat tahen,” a ci hi.
Hih thu khempeuh ah gamtat khialhna hangin Yahweh ngawhna tawh Iyyob in mawhna a bawl kei hi.
Khat vei leuleu Yahweh mai-ah Yahweh’ tapate a kilaak dingin hong pai uh ni khatin, Satan zong Yahweh mai-ah a kilaak dingin amaute lakah a pai hi.
Yahweh in Satan kiangah, “Koi pan hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Satan in Yahweh dawngin, “Leitung ah kileh kawikawi-in, ka paisuk ka paitohna pana hong pai ka hi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Satan kiangah, “Ka nasempa Iyyob na ngaihsun kha hiam? Leitung ah amah tawh a kibang Yahweh zahtakin gitlohna a peel paubaanna a nei lo, a thutang khat beek omlo hi. Tua hi a, thu om lopi-in amah suksiat ding ama langah Kei nong zol hangin amah in ama cihtakna len tinten veve hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Satan in Yahweh dawngin, “Vun tangin vun! Mi khat in ama nuntak nadingin a neih khempeuh pia mah ding hi!
Ahih hangin Na khut zankhia-in ama sa leh a guhte vat lecin, tua ciangin amah in Na mai panin Nang hong samsia pah ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Satan dawngin, “En in! Nangma vangliatna ah amah om hi! Ahih hangin ama nuntakna na hawi hamtang ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Satan in Yahweh’ omna mun nusia-in, vun natna a na valval leh, a khe taw panin a luzang dong a na mahmah meima tum tawh Iyyob a nasak hi.
Amah in a kikhuat nadingin leibeel kitam them neng khat la-in vut lakah a tu hi.
Tua ciangin a zi in ama kiangah, “Ki citaksak tentan lai ding na hi hiam? Yahweh samsia inla, si suk in!” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amah in tuanu kiangah, “Nebalah; thuheihna a nei lo numei hai, khat bangin na pau hi. Yahweh kiang panin lawhcinna sang i hih ciangin haksatna zong i san ding hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Hih thu khempeuh ah Iyyob in kampauna tawh mawhna a bawl kei hi.

Iyyob lawm thumte in ama tunga thupiang haksatna khempeuh a zak uh ciangin, amau omna ciat panin a pai uh hi. Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuh mi Bildad, leh Naamath mi Zophar-te in amah hehnem ding leh a hanthawn-a pai dingin kituahkhop ding a geel uh hi.

Amaute in a gamla panin amah a muh uh ciangin, amah a thei pak kei uh hi; tua ciangin amaute in a kap khia beba uh hi. Khat ciat in a puantual uh balkekin, vantung lamah leivui thehto-in a lu tungah leivui a theh uh hi.
Sun sagih leh zan sagih amah tawh amaute leilak ah a tukhawm uh hi. Ama thuakna a liat mahmahna mu uh ahih manin kuamah in kam khat beek tawh amah hopih lo uh hi.

headings.text: Iyyob in a Suah Ni Samsia

verses.text: Hih khit ciangin Iyyob a kamka-in, ama suahni a samsia hi.
Iyyob pau-in a gen inah:
“Ka suah ni leh, zanin, ‘Ta pasal khat suak hi,’ a kicih ni beimang tahen.
Tua sun—a mialcipin kikhel henla, tunga Yahweh in tua sun awlmawh kei hen, tua sunin khuavak zong taang kei hen.
Khuamial leh sihna liimin khuh cip henla, a tungah meii tengcipin, sunin khimzingin tua sun kihtak huaisak tahen.
Tua zan—khuamial in mancip henla, kum khut sunga nite lakah kisim loin, kha simnate sungah zong kihel nawn kei tahen.
Tua zanin ta piang kei tahen. Tua zanin lungdamna aw ging kei hen.
Tua ni a samsiat theite in tua zan samsiat ta uh hen. A thuum a tau dingin a kigingsa mite kapkhia uh henla, tua ni samsiat uh hen.
Ama zingsang aksite mial hen. A vak ngei lo ding sun-khuavak ngak niloh hen. Zingsang phalvak mu ngei kei hen;
bang hang hiam cihleh ka mitte panin haksatna a selcip dingin tua in kei hong kipaiina naugil kongkhakte na khakcip lo hi.
Bang hangin a sisa-in suak lo ka hi hiam? Naubu panin ka suah phetin bang hangin sipah lo ka hi hiam?
Bang hangin kei hong tawi ding phei om se a, kei hong kivak nading nawi om se ahi hiam?
-14 Tua hi leh, tu-in dai takin kei hong kisial khin ding hi. Ka ihmu khin ding a, tu-in a kisiasa ahi amau aa dingin a lam leitung kumpite leh thudotte tawh ka tawlnga khin ding hi;
Amau inn ngun tawh a kidim kham tampi a nei uliante tawh ka ihmu khin ding hi.
Bang hangin a hun cing lo-a suakte bang leh khuavak a mu ngei lo naungek khat bangin lei sungah hong kiselcip lo ahi hiam?
Lei sungah gilote in hong nawngkaisak nawn lo ding uh a, a gimte a tawlnga hithiat ding hi.
Lei sungah galmat silate zong tawlnga hithiat ding uh a, sila ukpa’ otna zong a za nawn kei ding uh hi.

A neu a lian tua lai-ah om uh a, silate zong a ukpa kiang panin a suakta hi. 20-21 A lungkham mipa tungah bang hangin khuavak kipia ahi hiam? Sih ding a lunggulh neungau napi-in a si thei lo, nuntak haksa a sa mahmah mipa tungah bang hangin nuntakna kipia ahi hiam? Suang manpha a zong mipa sangin sih ding a zong mite,
hankhuk a tun ciangin lungdamin a kipaak ding mite tungah bang hangin nuntakna kipia zawsop ahi hiam?
A lampi a kiseelsak, Yahweh in dai sungah a umcip mipa tungah nuntakna kipia se ahi hiam?
Ka nek ma-in ka khuisa a, kei kiang panin ka tauna tui bangin a luangkhia hi.
Ka kihtaktak thu ka tungah hong tung ta a, ka laulau thu ka tuak kha hi.
Ka tawlnga ngei kei a, ka dai dide thei kei hi! Lungnopna ka nei kei a, lungkhamna vive a kizom den hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Teman mi Eliphaz in a gen inah:
“Tu-in nang tungah khat in thu khat hong gen ngam leh na thuak zo ding hiam? Ahih hangin gen loin kua om zo ding ahi hiam?
Thu na hilhsa mi tampite en inla, a khut kham mite na thakhauhsak hi.
A puk dek mite na kammal tawh na hanthawn a, khuk zawte na khauhsak hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in hih thute hong tun ciangin nang na lungkia hi. Tua in nang hong vatin na patau hi.
A zahtakhuai na gamtatzia pen na kimuanna ding hilo ahi hiam? Na paubaan om lohna ziate pen na lametna ding hilo ahi hiam?
Hih thu ngaihsun in: mawh nei lo mite kisusia ngei ahi hiam? Thumaan mite koi lai-ah kisusia ngei ahi hiam?
Mawhna lo-a a khote leh buaina a vawh mite in tua bangmah a at lam ka thei hi.
Yahweh’ husanna tawh tua bang mite sia uh a, Ama hehna hu tawh amaute a kangtum uh hi.
Humpi hawk ding a, a teek humpi ngik ding hi; ahih hangin humpi moite’ ha a kitan ciangin,
an tuh zawh lohna hangin si uh a, humpinelkai anute’ tanote a kitehthang hi.
Thu khat kei kiangah simtham takin hong kipuak a, ka bilte in tua thu ging hiau a za hi.
Zanin a nawnkaisak mangte tawh mite a ihsip laitakin,
launa leh dipkuatna in kei hong matcip a, ka pumpi a liing hi.
Kha khat in ka mai hong nawk a, ka khuasik mul a tho hi.
Khawl vat na pi-in bang hiam cih ka gen thei kei hi. Ka mai-ah a ding dan khat om hi. Dai dide a, tua khit ciangin awging khat ka za hi:
‘Yahweh sangin a si thei mihing thumaanzaw thei ding ahi hiam? Amah a Bawlpa sangin mihing khat siangzaw thei ding ahi hiam?
Amah in a nasemte muang zo loin, a vantung mite khialsak ahih leh,
amau bulpi leivui ahi: buan innte; buan pumpite, sunga a tengte, lungno khat sangin gawizan ding bangzah takin baihzaw tham ding ahi hiam?
Zingsang leh nitak kikalin amaute kithehnen uh hi. Amaute a tawntungin mangthang uh a, kuamah in phawkkha lo hi.
Amaute in pilna ngah masa lopi-in a sih theih nadingun a puanbuk khaute uh khaito lopi-in khin uh hilo ahi uh hiam?’ hong ci hi.
Tu-in samkhia in; ahih hangin khatpeuh in nang hong dawng ding ahi hiam? Nangma tangin hong thumsak dingin a siangthote kua pen kiang lamah kihei ding na hi hiam?
Hehna in mi hai khat that a, hazatna in mimawl khat thatlum hi.
Keimah in a kikhual mihai khat ka mu a, ahih hangin thakhatin ama inn kisamsia hi.
Muanhuaina panin a tate kigamla a, a hu khat beek om loin thutang takin a kisepna kulhkongpite ah a kigawicip hi.
Gilkialna in lingkungte nangawn panin la-in ama ankungte netum a, dangtaakna in amau hauhna teng a diiktum hi.
Leilak panin haksatna hong piang tawm lo a, lei sung panin gentheihna hong pokhia lo hi.
Mei-ekte a tung lamah a lentoh bang teekteekin, mihing zong haksatna thuak ding maha suak ahi hi.
Ahih hangin tua pen kei hi zenzen leng, Yahweh ka zong ding a, Yahweh kiangah ka thu teng ka ap ding hi;
Amah pen taksa tawh theih zawh loh a lamdang lianpite a bawlpa, sim zawh loh nalamdangte a bawlpa hi a,
leitung ah guah zusakin, lote ah tui a luangsakpa,
a kiniamkhiatte a sangna ah a tawisang, a thuumte lungmuanna ah a lamtopa ahi hi.
Amah in lungsim kawite sawmsimna suksiatsak ahih manin amaute sepkhiatna a mawkna a suak hi.
Amah in a zuau pil amau geelnate tawh mipilte man a, amau kawipilna tawh a ngimnate a kisiacipsak hi.
Sun hunin amaute khuamial tawh kituak uh a, sunkim pi mahin zan bangin miallak a zawt uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in namsau pan, a thahatte kam sung pan leh amau ukcipna panin a tasam mite a hon hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kiniamkhiat mite in lametna nei uh a, a thutang lo kam pen kikhakcip hi.
En in, Yahweh puahphat mipa thupha ngah hi a, tua ahih ciangin Vanglianpenpa’ thuhilhna nial kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a liamsak hangin amah in a liamna zong tunsak hi. Amah in nasakin, ama khut in a damsak hi.
Amah in haksatna guk panin nang hong hon ding hi. Hi hi, a sagihna ah siatna khat beek in nang hong sukha lo ding hi.
Kialpi sungah Amah in sihna panin nang hong hon ding hi. Gal sungah namsau hong sat nading panin hong hon ding hi.
Leii tawh satna panin; phuisamna leh bumna panin, nang hong kikem ding a, dawi hong pai ciangin zong na kihta kei ding hi.
Van kisuh gawpna leh kialpite na nuihsan lel ding a, gamsa gilote zong na lau kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh gam sung dawite langah Yahweh tawh thuciamna khat na nei ding a, gamlak gamsate, nang tawh a kilem ding uh hi.
Na puanbuk a lungmuanhuai lam na thei ding a, na neihsate na sittel ciangin a kisam bangmah na mu kei ding hi.
Tua banah na suanlekhak tampi pha-in, na suanlekhakte leitunga lopa tawh kibat ding lam na thei ding hi.
A hun a cin ciangin buh lomte a kilak mah bangin kum cing takin na hankhuk ah na pai ding hi.
Hih thute ka kantel uh a, tua thu a man ahi hi. Za in la, nang tungah kibulh pah in,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Iyyob in dawngin a gen inah:
Aw, ka lunggimna kitawiteh thei lo a, ka dah luatna tawitehna tungah kikhoih thei lo hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen tuipi-a sehnelte sangin gikzaw ding hi—tua ahih ciangin ka kidopna om loin phulkhia gawp hi.
Vanglianpenpa’ thaltangte in kei hong kha a, ka kha in a thaltang gu dawn hi. Yahweh’ lauhuainate in kei langah pangin mun la uh hi.
Gam laate, lonona ah ham uh ahi hiam, ahih keileh bawngtal, an a kipiak ciangin ham ahi hiam?
An limlote ci sawh loin kine ahi hiam? Aktui dakang in limna nei ahi hiam?
Ka nek nop loh an sianglote bangin ka pumpi uih hi.
Aw, ka ngetna ngah hileng maw! Yahweh in ka lunggulhna hong pia hileh maw!
Yahweh in kei hong gawi-in a khut ip loin kei hong susia nuam ding hileh maw!
Ahih hangin tu-in hih pen keima kihehnepna bek hi lel a, hih zahtaka ka thuakna sung nagawn ah nuamin ka kipaak a, hih thu ah Siangtho Pa’ Thukhamte ka nial kei hi.
Tu dongin ka thuak zawh lai nadingin bang thakhauhna nei ka hi hiam? Lungduai taka ka om nadingin bang gualzawhna lam-en lai ding ka hi hiam?
Suang bangin thakhauhna nei ka hi hiam? Ka satakte sumngo tawh a kibawl ahi hiam?
Tu-in gualzawhna in kei hong nusiat nungsang kei le kei ka kihuh nadingin vangliatna khatpeuh nei ka hi hiam?
Lametna bei mipa a lungkim loin Yahweh zahtakna a nei nawn pial ahih leh zong a lawmte’ cihtakna a kisam hi.
Ahih hangin ka sanggmte pen a kimuang thei lo sehnel gama luitui leh tuk huna tuisam phul bang uh a,
nin a khalhnelh vuuk, vuuk a tui cianga a kang,
ahih hangin khua keu hun ciangin a luang nawn lo, khuakhal nisat hun ciangin a luanna ah a mangthang tuite tawh kibang hi.
Amaute in manawn na mel nei loin amau lampite ah pai kawikawi uh a, tua khit ciangin a mangthang uh hi.
Tema khualzinte in tui zong uh a, Sheba khualzinte in zong lunggulh uh hi;
Amaute in a maun mahmah uh hangin a lungkham uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua teng a tun uh ciangin amaute lungkia mang ding uh hi.
Note zong kei tungah tua bang mah na hi uh hi; ka gualzawh ciangin nong citak uh a, ka haksat ciangin nong citak kei uh hi! A kihtakhuai khatpeuh na muh uh ciangin na laugawp pah uh hi.
Note tungah, “Khatpeuh hong pia un. Na sum uh tawh hong tan un,” hong ci ngei ka hi hiam?
“Ka galpa vangliatna panin hong honkhia un. Kei hong nengniam mite khut sung panin hong tankhia un,” hong ci ngei ka hi hiam?
Ka sep khialhna a om leh hong hilh un, ka thugen ka tawp pah ding hi! Koi tengah khial ka hiam, hong lak un!
Phattuamna nei kammalte lungkimhuai mahmah a; ahih hangin nong mawhsakna un bang phattuamna nei ahi hiam?
Ka gensa thu puahphat sawm-in, huih letmang bangin lamet bei mipa’ kammalte thupi ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?
Tagah khat aa dingin ai na ngawn lawn-in, na lawmpa uh na zuakmang sawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in kei hong en un. Note maitang ah kong khem ngei kei ding hi.
Tu-in hong kihei un; thutan lohna om kei tahen! Hi hi, enkik un! Ka thumaanna kip mahmah hi!
Ka kam sungah khialhna om ahi hiam? Ka dang in a sia nate khentel thei lo hi uh hiam?
Leitung ah mihing in nasep haksa sep ding nei hi lo ahi hiam? Ama nuntak nite pen a cial nasem mite mah tawh kibang hilo ahi hiam?
Nilim a lunggulh sila khat bangin, ama thaman a ngak lah mahmah a kicial mipa bangin,
a mawkna-in kha tampi sung ka om a, a gimhuai zante kei aa dingin kiseh hi.
Ka lup ciangin, keimah in, ‘Ka thawh ma hun bang tan a sau tam?’ ka ci hi. Zan sawt mahmah a, khuavak mateng ka kigawigawi hi.
Ka pumpi ah than leh meima khemte tawh kidim a, ka vun kitamin a naiphual hi.
Siamgante siam ciangtang sangin ka nite manlang zaw a, lametna om lopi-in a mong tung pak hi.
Yahweh aw, ka nuntakna in husan khat bek ahih lam leh ka mit in lawhcinna a muhkik ngei nawn loh ding lam hong phawk in.
Kei hong mu mit in kei hong mu nawn lo ding a, Nangmah in kei nong zong ding hi; ahih hangin kei ka om nawn kei ding hi.
Meiilum kaite bei-in a manthan bangin, han sung a tungsa mipa a kahtokik kei hi.
Ama inn ah cikmahin ciahkik nawn lo ding a, ama innkuanpihte in amah mu nawn lo ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in ka kam ka ip kei ding hi! ka lunggim manin ka paukhia ding a, ka lungkham manin ka phun ding hi.
Kei, tuipi ka hi hiam? Ka kammalte na khak tan liang na dingun kuam thukpi sunga gulpi ka hi hiam?
Keimah in, ‘Lum leng nuam ding a, ka lupna in ka lungkamna teng beisak ding hi,’ cileng lah,
mangmatnate tawh kei nong lausak a, mangmuhnate tawh kei hong liinglawngsak hi;
tua ahih ciangin ka guhte sungah ka nuntak lai ding sangin kitawlsanin sih ding ka lungsim a utzaw hi!
Ka nuntakna ka cimtak hi! A nungta tawntung ding lah ka hi kei hi. Kei bek hong hici nusiat lel in; bang hang hiam cihleh ka nuntak hunte pen husan khat ahi lel hi.
Na thupit bawl dingin mihing bang hilel ahi hiam? Amah na lunghihmawh nadingin mihing bang hilel ahi hiam?
Zingsang simin sittelin, a hun sima na ze-et tham dingin mihing bang ahi hiam?
Tomkha sung beek hong pelh lo ding a, ka cil beek khit mateng kei bek hong omsak lo ding na hi hiam?
Bangci bangin mawh ka hi hiam? Mi encikpa aw, Nang tungah ka khilhna bang ahi hiam? Keima vangik keimah ka hih nadingin bang hangin nangma ngimna-in kei hong teel na hi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ka thupalsatna hong maisak lo ding na hi hiam? Bang hangin ka mawhna hong maisak lo ding na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh a sawt loin leivui lakah a puksuk ta ding hi. Nangmah in kei nong zong ding a, kei ka om nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shuh mi Bildad in a gen inah:
“Tua bang thute bang tanvei gengen lai ding na hi hiam? Na kammalte huihsia nung tawh kibang hi!
Yahweh in thukhenna hoih heikhia-in nasem ahi hiam? Vanglianpenpa in thutang lehzat ahi hiam?
Ama tungah na tate a mawh uh leh, Amah in amau mawhnate hangin thukik ding hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in Yahweh lam bek na et a, Vanglianpenpa kiang thuumin,
nang, siangtho-in thumaan hi zenzen lecin, tu-in nang aa dingin Amah khanglo khin ding a, na dinmun man ah hong koihkik khin ding hi.
Tua ciangin na hun beisate bangmah lo hong bang ding a, na mailam ah nakpi-in na lawhcing ding hi.

thutang a kisepna kulhkongpite ah hamphatna ka neih lam thei pi mahin pa nei nawn lote langpanin ka khut ka liik leh—
ka liang tung panin ka khut kia tahen! A tangte panin ka khut kibotkhia tahen!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kiang pana suksiatna pen kei aa dingin lauhuai lua a, Ama liatluatna ka launa hangin tua bang nate ka sem ngei kei ding hi!
Ka lametna kham ka hihsak a, kham citak kiangah, ‘Ka lungmuanna nang hi teh!’ ci ka hih leh,
ka hauhna a liatna hang ahih keileh ka khutte in hauhna lianpi a ngahzawhna hangin kisial ka ahih leh,
ahih keileh, Kha Thak nite ahi a, Pawi hunte aa dingin ahi zongin etsakna a khawm tuah dingin nitang khuavak ka et taak leh,
a simthamin ka lungsim hong kizol a, ka kam pana zahtak lakna kinapna khat ka khut in amaute pia leh,
Tua zong pen lehhek mawhna hi ding hi! Tua bang hileh a sangna a om Yahweh a lehhek suak ding ka hih manin, ka thu in thukhenna a thuak dingin kilawm hi!
Kei hong mudah mipa kisiatna hangin lungdamin, ahih keileh haksatna a thuak ciangin nuamin a kisial ka hih leh—
ama tungah samsiatna a tun ding deihna tawh mawhna bawl dingin ka kam ka phal kei hi—
Ka innkuan sunga mite in, ‘Ama sate tawh a gilvah lo kua om ahi hiam?’ ci ngei lo ahih uh leh,
kualzinte aa dingin ka kong hong den ka hih manin khualmi khatpeuh lamdung ah ka lumsak ngei kei hi.
Ka khialhna ka lungsim ah seelcipin Adam bangin ka thupalsatna khuhcip ka hih leh;
mihon lianpite ka kihtakna hang leh, ka behte a kisimmawh ding ka lau-na hangin daitakin omin, kongkhak panin pusuak lo ka hih leh,
Yahweh in ka thu hong ngaihsak ding hi! Ka lunggulhna pen Vanglianpenpa in ka thu hong ngaihsak ding ahi hi! Kei hong Mawhsakpa in hong mawhsakna lai sungah gelh tahen!
Tua pen ka liangko tungah ka suang ding a, kumpi-lukhu bangin ka khu ding hi.
Ka khekap phazah Ama tungah ka pulak ding a, kumpi-tapa khat bangin ama lamah ka pai ding hi.
Ka leitang in kei langpanin a kiko a, kahna hangin a sunga tuma a kuakte a kawt leh,
bangmah pia loin tua leitanga piangte ka nek a, ahih keileh ka lo nasemte ka puksihsak ahih leh,
mangbuh tangin lingkungte hong po henla, mangbuh-ham tangin tahum hong po hen!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih mi thumte in Iyyob dawng nawn lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Iyyob amah le amah thumaan a kisa hi.
Ahih hangin Iyyob amah le amah Yahweh sangin kithutangsak zaw ahih manin Iyyob tungah Ram beh Buz mi Barachel’ tapa Elihu a heh mahmah hi.
Tua banah a lawmte teng thum tungah zong amah a heh mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Iyyob nial zo lo uh a, tua ahih ciangin Iyyob a mawhsak uh hi.
Tu-in amah sangin amaute kum tampi upazaw ahih manin Elihu in ama pau hun ding ngak a,
ahih hangin a lawmte teng thum in a kam uh tawh a dawnkik loh ding lam Elihu in a theih ciangin a heh mahmah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Buz mi Barachel’ tapa Elihu pau-in, “Kei ka kum tawm a, note ka khangham uh hi. Tua thu hangin ka lau a, ka theihna note tungah kong gen ngam kei hi.
Keimah in ka lungsim sungah, ‘Kum in thu hong gen ding a, kum tampi in pilna hong hilh ding hi,’ ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Ahih hangin mihing sungah kha om a, Vanglianpenpa’ hu in mihing tungah thutheihna pia hi.
Kum tampi a pha mite a pil hipah sam lo a, khanghamna in vaihawmna a theitel den hi sam lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kong gen nop in: Ka thu hong ngai un. Ke’n zong ka ngaihsutna kong genkhia ding hi.
A taktakin na paukhiat ding uh ka ngak a, na kinialnate uh ka ngai hi. Tua banah, note in na thugen ding uh na zonzon laitak un,
limtak pha takin kong ngai hi; ahih hangin note khat beek in Iyyob na mawhsak zo kei uh hi; note khat beek in ama hong nialnate na dawngkik thei kei uh hi.
Kei tungah, ‘Pilna ka mu uh hi. Mihing ahi lo, Yahweh in amah taai hen,’ hong ci kei un.
Ahih hangin Iyyob in kei tawh thu hong kinailpih lo hi; tua ahih ciangin note nialna tawh amah ka dawng kei ding hi.
Iyyob aw, amaute patau-in, a gen beh thei nawn kei uh a, a cih nading mel a thei kei uh hi.
Amaute tawpin hong dawng nawn lo uh a, gen ding thei lo amaute ngak lai ding ka hi hiam?
Kei zong gen ding ka nei a, kei zong ka theihna kong gen ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh gen ding thu tampi ka nei a, ka sunga om kha in kei hong sawl tantan hi.
Thawl sunga om leenggahzu tawh ka kibang a, leenggahzu um thak a phukham ding leenggahzu tawh ka kibang hi.
Kong gen hamtang ding hi; tua ciangin ka lung a nuam pan ding hi. Ka kamka-in kong dawng ding hi.
Kuamah ka deidan kei ding a, mi khatpeuh zong ka pumphat kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mi pumphat dan ka thei kei a, tua cih mawk leng kei hong Bawlpa in kei hong lakhia mang pah ding hi!
Ahi zongin Iyyob aw, ka thugen za in. Ka gen peuhpeuh na ngai in.
Tu-in ka kam ka ka a, ka kammalte ka leii dawn tungta hi.
Ka kammalte a thutang lungsim panin hong pai hi a, ka mukte in siangtho takin thutheihna a genkhia hi.
Yahweh’ Kha in kei hong bawlin, Vanglianpenpa’ hu in nuntakna hong pia hi.
Nong dawn theih leh hong dawng in. Na mawhsak nading kiging inla, hong maituah in.
Yahweh mai-ah nang mah bang teekteek ka hi a, kei zong tungman pana hong kila mah ahi hi.
Ka lauhuaina in nang hong lauthawngsak lo ding a, ka lunggimna hong kisuan lo ding hi.
A taktakin nangmah in ka zakna ah thu na gen a, bang hang hiam cihleh na kammal gingte ka za a,
‘Thu palsat loin ka siang hi! Ka mawhbaang kei hi! Ka sungah khialhna khat beek omlo hi!
Tua hi napi-in Amah in kei langah mawhna mu veve a, Ama galpa bangin hong ngaihsun hi!
Amah in ka khe kol hong bulhin, ka kalsuanna khempeuh hong encik hi,’ na ci hi.
Ahih hangin hih thu ah na man lohna kong gen hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen mihing sangin lianzaw hi.
Amah in na thugente hong dawng kei tah ci-in bang hangin Amah tot bawl se na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in lam tuamtuam tawh hong gen ding a, ahih hangin mihing in thei zo lo uh hi.
Lupna tungah amaute ihmu-in a ihsip uh ciangin mangmatna sung, zan hun mangmuhna sungah,
Amah in mite’ bil honsakin, vauhilhna tawh amaute lausak ding a,
gitlohna panin mite a kihei theih nading, a kiphatsak loh nading,
hankhuk panin ama nuntakna a kepsak nading, namsau tawh sihna panin ama nuntakna a kepsak nading ahi hi.
Tua bang hi keileh, lupna tungah natna thuakin, khawl hun nei loin a guh sung a teep ngaungau natna tawh mihing kithuhilh ding a,
ama hinna mahmah in an kihin, ama nuntakna in an lim mahmahte a kih dong tuaci ding hi.
A cilesa siamang a, a guhguak bek a kimu hi.
Hi hi, amah in hankhuk zuan dek ta a, ama nuntakna in sihna kamtaite kiang zuan dek ta hi.
Tua hi napi-in, mihing tungah Yahweh’ thutanna a lak dingin tul lak pan khat, a genkhia ding, ama pangah vantungmi khat a om leh,
Yahweh in ama hehpih ding a, ‘Hankhuk zuat ding pengsak un! Ama kitat nading khat ka mukhin hi,’ a ci hi.
Naupangno khat aa bangin a satak nosuak ding hi. A khangnolai hun-a bangin a hikik ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh tungah thungen ding a, Amah in a sang ding hi. Amah in lungdamin Ama maitang mu ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in Ama thumaanna mihing tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin mihingte kiangah amah hong pai-in, ‘Ka mawhzo a, thu man ka lehhei hi; tua in kei phattuamna hong pia lo hi,’ a ci hi.
Amah in hankhuk zuatna panin hong tankhia a, khuavak nuamsa dingin ka nungta ding hi.
En in, mihing aa dingin Yahweh in hih thute khempeuh ni vei tham lo, thumvei nangawn hih a,
nuntakna khuavak mihing tungah a taangin, hankhuk panin a kilehkik dingin a hih ahi hi.
Iyyob aw, na bil hong ngat inla, ka thu hong ngai in. Dai takin na om in, thu kong gen ding hi.
Gen ding khatpeuh na neih leh, hong dawng inla, genkhia in; bang hang hiam cihleh na thu man ding ka deih hi!
Ahih hangin gen ding na neih kei leh, ka thu na ngai in. Dai takin om inla, keimah in pilna kong hilh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Elihu in zom lai-in a gen inah:
“No mipilte aw, ka kammalte za un. No thutheihna a neite aw, ka thu hong ngai un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh kam in an a ciap bang teekteekin, bil in kammalte a sittel hi.
Thu man bang hiam cih teel ni. Eite kikal ah a man bang hiam cih khensat ni.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Iyyob in, ‘Kei ka thumaan hi; ahih hangin Yahweh in ka thutanna hong nial hi.
Kei a man ka hih hangin a zuau khat bangin hong kingaihsun hi. Thupalsatna bangmah ka neih loh hangin ka liamna dam thei lo hi.
Simmawhna tui bangin a dawn Iyyob tawh a kibang mi mu ngei na hi hiam?
Amah pen a gitloh gamtatte tawh kithuahin, migilote a kipawlpa ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Iyyob in, ‘Mihing in Yahweh lungkimsak ding a hanciam hangin phattuamna bangmah om lo hi,’ a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin no thuthei mite aw, ka thu hong ngai un. Yahweh in siatna bawl peuhmah lo hi! Vanglianpenpa in mawhna bawl peuhmah lo hi!
Hi lo hi! Mihing in a sepsa tawh kizui-in Yahweh in thaman pia hi! Ama gamtatna tawh kituak thaman a zong dingin mihing a bawl hi.
Hi hi! Yahweh in cikmahin siatna bawl lo ding a, Vanglianpenpa in thutang heikhia lo ding hi!
Amah in leitung a uk dingin kua seh ahi hiam? Amah in leitung buppi ah thunei-in kua koih ahi hiam?
Tuate Ama lungsim ah omin, Amah in a Kha leh a hu dokkik hi leh,
mihing khempeuh beimang khawm ding a, mihing khempeuh leivui suakkik ding hi.
Tu-in thutheina nei na hih leh, hih thu za in! Ka kammal gingte ngai in!
Thutang a mudah mi khat in gam-uk ding ahi hiam? A Thutang leh a Vanglian Khat mawhsak ding na hi hiam?
Nangmah in kumpipa kiangah, ‘Na gilo hi!’ ci-in, kumpi-tapate kiangah, ‘Kimanna na nei kei uh hi!’ ci ngam ding na hi hiam?
Tua hi napi-in Amah in kumpi-tapate zong gumtuam tuan lo a, mizawngte sangin mihaute zong a pahtawizaw tuan kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute khempeuh pen Ama khut tawh a bawl ahi uh hi.
Zan kim laitak tomno sungin amaute si uh hi. Mite liingin simang uh a, mihing khut tawh loin thahatna teng a kihemkhia hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama mitte in mihingte lampite en gige hi. Amah in amau kalsuanna khempeuh a mu hi.
Mawhna silate kibukna mun khuamial ahi a, sihna liim ahi zongin a om kei hi;
tua ciangin Yahweh mai-ah thukhenna thuak dingin amah a tun ciangin Yahweh in mihing a sittel beh lai ding kisam lo hi.
Amah in a thu kan se loin a thahatte suzan a, amau mun ah adangte a koih hi.
Amah in amau nasepnate thei ahih mannin, zanin amaute lawnpaai a, amaute a kitamzan uh hi.
A kimawhsak mite bangin Amah in adangte muhtangpi-in amaute a sattuk hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Amah zui loin pial uh a, Ama lampite ngaihsutin a nei kei uh hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Ama mai-ah micimawhte kahna tun uh a, tua ciangin Amah in a gentheite kahna a za hi.
Amah in bangmah hih kei taleh zong, kua in Amah mawhsak ding ahi hiam? Amah in a maitang seel leh, kua in Amah mu thei ding ahi hiam?
Tua thangsiahna ah mite a awk loh nading, mihoih kineihkhemte a uksak loh nadingin Amah in mi khat leh minam khat a kibangin a uk hi.
Mi khatpeuh in Yahweh kiangah, ‘Ka khial hi; ahih hangin ka khial nawn kei ding hi,’ ci ngei ahi hiam?
Mi khatpeuh in, ‘Ka muh theih nadingin hong hilh in; ka khialhnasa a om leh, tuate ka hih nawn kei ding hi,’ ci ngei ahi hiam?
Tavuan lak ding nial na hih manin Yahweh in hong pakta ding sa na hi hiam? Amah teel ding hi loin nangma teel ding hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin hong gen in; bang thei na hi hiam?
Thu theitel mite in kei kiangah hong gen ding a—ka thu a za mipil khatpeuh in:
‘Thu thei lopi-in Iyyob pau hi! Ama kammalte pilna kihel lo hi!’ hong ci ding uh hi.
Aw, Iyyob in migolo khat bangin a dawnkikna hangin amah kize-et suak zen leh maw!
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in ama mawhna banah langdo lailai a, eite lakah a khut beeng lai-in, Yahweh langpanna kammal a behlaplap lai hi!” a ci hi.
Elihu in dawng lai a,
“Nangmah in, ‘Ka thumaanna pen Yahweh aa sangin thumaan zaw hi,’ ci-in na gen hih thu mansa na hi hiam?
Tua hi napi-in nangmah in Ama kiangah, ‘Nang tunga thumaanna in bang phattuamna om ahi hiam? A mawh hileng bang ngahbeh lai ding ka hi hiam?’ ci-in na dong hi.
Nang leh nang tawh a om na lawmte kong dawng ding hi.
Vantungte en unla, mu un. Note sangin a sangzaw meiite en un.
Na mawh uh leh, Amah langah bang tangtun na hi uh hiam? Na thupalsatnate uh tampi a phak leh zong, Amah bang cih thei tuan na hi uh hiam?
Na thumaan uh leh, Ama tungah na piak uh bang ahi hiam? Na thumaan uh leh, note khut panin Ama ngah bang ahi tuan ahi hiam?
Na gitlohna in nang tawh a kibang lel mihing bek sukha a, na thumaanna in zong mihing’ tapate mah sukha lel hi.
Mihonpi bawlsiatna hangin mite kiko uh a, a thakhauh khut langpanin a huh ding a ngen uh hi.
Ahih hangin kuamah in, ‘Zanin a lungdamhuai late hong pia, kei hong Bawl Yahweh koi-ah om ahi hiam?
Amah pen leitung gamsate tawh eite hong hilh, huilak vasate tawh eite hong pilsakpa ahi hi.
Taksa lunggulh mite kiko uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh in dawng lo hi. Bang hangin hici ahi hiam? Migilote kiphatsakna hang ahi hi!
Hi takpi hi, Yahweh in kimanna nei lo thu ngai lo ding a, Vanglianpenpa in thudon lo ding hi.

Nangmah in ‘Amah ka mu thei kei hi,’ ci na hih ciangin Yahweh in bangzah takin nang thu hong ngaizaw tham ding ahi hiam? Tua hi napi-in Ama omna ah thutanna om a, ahih hangin Amah na ngak pelmawh ding hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in Yahweh in Ama hehna tawh dantatpah lo a, thupalsatna a thudon lo tawh kibang ahih manin,
Kimanna nei lopi-in Iyyob a kamka a, a thei lopi-in a paupau hi!” a ci hi.
Elihu in thugei a,
“Tawmvei hong thuak tentan lai in; Yahweh’ tangin kong gen ding a omlai thute kong lak ding hi.
Gamla pek panin ka ciimna kong paipih ding a, kei hong Bawlpa thumaan mah hi ka ci ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a taktakin, ka kammalte zuau thu hi lo a, thutheihna a kicingpa in nang hong ompih hi.
En in, Yahweh vanglianin, Amah in kuamah a simmawh kei hi. Amah pen a thahat, a ciim leh a pil mahmah ahi hi.
Amah in migilote hingkhawi lo a, ahih hangin a kinengniamte tungah a thutang hi.
Amah in a thumaan mite kiang panin a mit heikhia lo a, a kip tawntung kumpi-tokhom ah kumpite tawh amaute koih khawm ding a, amaute kitawisang ding hi.
Ahih hangin mite sikkol kibulhin, thuaksakna khaute tawh kihencip leh,
Amah in a hih kaltang a mawhnate uh leh a thupalsatnate uh, amau gamtatnasate a lak hi.
Taii hilhna leh thuhilhnate a zak theih nadingun Amah in amau bil zong honsak a, gamtatsiatna panin a kiheikik nadingun thu pia hi.
Amaute in a thu mangin Ama na sem le uh, amau nuntak sungin daupaina leh thupha ngah ding uh a, a khan sau-in nuamsa ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in Ama thu a man kei uh leh, Yahweh’ thukhenna namsau tawh amaute kisusia ding a, thutheihna nei loin a si ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin mihoih kineihkhemte a lungsim ah heh niloh a, Amah in dan piakna tawh a thuhilh ciangin Ama kiangah a kiko kei uh hi.
Amaute khansih uh hi. Amau nuntakna pen qedesh-te; elohim biakna ngeina-a pasal kizuakte leh a paktatte, lakah om uh hi.
Amah in amau thuakna panin a thuak mite hu a, lauhauina, kinetniamna leh haksatna tawh amau bilte a honsak hi.
Hi taktak hi, Yahweh in lungkhamna panin nang hong paikhiatpihin, thongkiat lohna mun tanzau ah hong omsak a, na sabuai tunga kilui dingte hauhna tawh kidim ding hi.
Ahih hangin migilote thuak ding thukhenna nang hong kisuan ahih leh, thukhenna leh thutang in nang hong lencip lai ding hi.
Hauhna tawh kuamah in nang hong zolkhak loh nadingin kidawm inla, sumgolh tampi in na lam khialh nadingin kizolkhasak kei in.
Na hauhna khempeuh leh na hauhna hanga na vangliatna khempeuh in na haksat hun ah Yahweh kiang hong cihsak thei ding ahi hiam?
Mite amau mun ah a kisatkhiat ciangin zan hun lunggulh kei in!
Kidawm inla, siatna lamah kihei kei in! Gitlohna panin na kihei theih nadignin nang tungah taii hilhna leh thuaksakna hong tung ahi hi.
En in, a vangliatna hangin Yahweh kitawisang a, kua in Amah bangin hilh ahi hiam?
Ama aa dingin kua in Ama lampite lak a, ama kiangah kua in, ‘Na gamta khial hi!’ ci thei ding ahi hiam?
Mite in lasakna tawh a phat uh Ama nasepna na liatsak ding phawk in.
Mi khempeuh in Yahweh’ nasepna en gige uh a, gamlapi panin a gal-et uh hi.
En in! Yahweh pen eite theihzawhzah sangin lianzaw a, telzawh ding hi lo hi! Ama kum phaza kisim zo lo a, theihzawh peuhmah ding hilo hi.
-28 Meiite sung panin a taksuk guahtui bangin tuihu panin taksuksak tuimalte Amah in kaito a, tua in mihing tungah a buaksuk dipdep hi.
Amah in meiite a zal zia ahi a, Ama buk panin van a ginsak zia ahi zongin khatpeuh in telzo ding ahi hiam?
En in, Amah in Ama kiimkot ah khuaphia zalh a, tuipi bulpite a tuamcip hi.
Hihte tawh Amah in minamte vak a, amaute an tampitak a pia hi.
Amah in a khut dimin kektang tawi a, a ciaptehna mun a khak nadingin thu a pia hi.
Ama vanging in gitlohna a langpang Khat ahi, Ama hong paina a tangko hi.
Hih thu ah ka lungtang kisai a, ama mun panin a zuankhia tawh a kibang hi.
Ama awging hih vanging leh Ama kam pana hong pai a ging damdam limtakin ngai dih un!
Vantung buppi nuai-ah Amah in khua phiasak hi! Amah in leimongte khempeuh dong ah a khuaphia sawl a,
tua khit ciangin Ama hawkna awging hong ging a, Amah in a thupitna awging tawh van a gingsak hi! Ama awging a kizak ciangin Amah in bangmah a iipkik kei hi.
Yahweh in a piandang Ama awging tawh van gingsak a, eite telzawh loh thu lianpite a sem hi.
Amah in vuk kiangah, ‘Leitung ah kia in,’ ci a, khuapi guah kiangah, ‘Buaksuk ziahziah in,’ a ci hi.
Ama bawlsa mi khempeuh in Ama nasepna a theih nadingin Yahweh in mi khempeuh nasepna a khawlsak hi.
Tua ciangin ganhingte amau kua ciat ah lut uh a, amau bukna ciat ah a lum uh hi.
Leitaw lam panin pingpei in notmang a, leilu lam panin huihpi in a vot mahmah tawh hong nawk hi.
Yahweh hu hangin tuikhal piangsak a, tui zaipite a khalmang hi.
Amah in meiipi nomsak a, tua sung tawnin Ama kektang a lawn hi.
Ama cihcihna zui-in meiite kikhin kawikawi uh a, Amah in amaute a thupiakna bangbangin leitung maitang bup tungah a sem uh hi.
Amah in mihing a kidop theih nading ahih keileh, a hehpihna hangin leitung tui a pia ding leh hehpih-itna a lak nadingin meii a zang hi.
Iyyob aw, hih thu za in! Khawl inla, Yahweh sep nalamdangte ngaihsun in!
Yahweh in meiite thu a piakzia leh Ama khuaphia tangzalzal a bawlzia na thei hiam?
Amah in meiite a khai linglengzia leh thutheihna ah a bukim Ama nalamdangte na thei hiam?
Amah in sa-in a khuah leitaw lam huih tawh leitung a daihsak dide lai-in na puan sungah bang hangin na khua-ul kai cih na thei hiam?
A kisung limlang bangin a khauh vanpi Amah tawh zal khawm thei na hi hiam?
Ama kiangah ka gen ding uh hong hilh in! Bangmah ka theih lohna uh hangin ka kiphelh thei kei uh hi.
Ka thugen nop Ama kiang kigen ding ding ahi hiam? Mihing in hopih ding hi zenzen leh, amah kivalhtum ding hilo ahi hiam?
Huihin a nawkin vante a sian ciangin a tang zah dinga a tang tungsol ni, tu nangawnin kuamah in en zo lo hi.

Humpinelkai leh a note a kua sungah bu-in a bukna muh ah sa a pang khinkhian uh ciangin humpinelkai khanglaite gilkialna vahsak thei na hi hiam?

Sathakte a suah hun ding thei na hi hiam? Sakhite a suah ciangin va vil na hi hiam?
A paii sung kha phaza sim na hi hiam? A suah hun uh thei na hi hiam?
Amaute boksukin, a tanote suaksak a, a natnate a lawnkhia uh hi.

Kua in gam-laate suahtakna pia ahi hiam? Kua in gam-laate a kamkaih phelsak ahi hiam?
Amau inn pen gamlak hi a, ci leitang pen amau tenna mun ahi hi.
Amah in khuasung gamlumna nuihsan lel a, leenghawlte awging a za kei hi.
Mualtungte ah an zongin a ututin pai kawikawi a, singkung lopa hing peuhpeuh a zuan kawikawi hi.
Gam-bawngtal in nangma na sem nuam ding a, na ganbuk ah hong giak nuam ding ahi hiam?
Lokaihna ah gam-bawngtal khauhualin kih zo ding na hi hiam? Na nung hong zui-in amah in mualkuamte kho ding ahi hiam?
Ama hat mahmahna ah kinga thei ding na hi hiam? Na nasep ding ama tungah nusiat thei ding na hi hiam?
Amah hong ciahkikin, na ancilna-a ante hong kaikhopsak dingin um na hi hiam?
Kalaoh-vasa in kiphatsakna tawh a khazaap a, ahih hangin tui vapi khate leh a multe tawh kitehkak thei lo hi.
Kalaoh-vasa in leilak ah a tuite nusia a, lei sungah a luumsak uh hi;
Khe khatpeuh in a sik khak ding, gamsa khatpeuh in a tuat khak ding a ngaihsun kei hi.
Amah in a tanote ama ta lo bang kekin ngong hih a, a gimnate a mawkna suakkha leh cih awlmawh lo hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ama pilna lakkhiatsak a, thutheihna zong a pia kei hi.
Tua hi na pi-in tai dingin a khate a zal ciangin, amah in sakol leh a tunga tuangpa a zahpih hi.
Sakol tungah thahatna pia na hi hiam? Sakol ngawngmul posak ngei na hi hiam?
Sakolte kauphe bangin diangsak thei-in a kihtakhuai-in a phitsak theipa na hi hiam?
Amah in huih lakah a khete lamto a, a thahatna suangin gal sungah a dianggawp hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in pingpei sung panin Iyyob dawng a,
“Tu-in ding inla, kipasal sak in; bang hang hiam cihleh nang thu kong dong ding a, Kei nong dawng ding hi!
Ka thukhenna khawlsak thei ding na hi hiam? Na thutan theih nadingin Kei hong mawhpaih ding na hi hiam?

A kiphasak peuhpeuh en inla, niamkhiat in! Migilote a dinna mun ah tuancil in.

Tua ciangin hih thu na sep theih leh, nangma taklam khut mahmah in nang hong hot theih lam ka taksang ding hi.

A kawnga a thahatna leh a gol mahmah a gilpi-a a vangliatna na mu hiam?
Amah in tamtak kung bangin a mei pek a, a phei saguite a kigak phitphet hi.

Ama kigin laitakin kua in amah man zo ding a, thangsiahin a nak vut zo ding ahi hiam?

A nak sungah khau khumin, sikkawi tawh a khaguh sunlet thei ding na hi hiam?
Amah in nang tungah thuna khatpeuh hong bawl ding ahi hiam? Nang tungah awzol hong zang ding ahi hiam?
Amah in nang tawh thuciamna bawl ding ahi hiam? A tawntunga na sila dingin amah la ding na hi hiam?
Vasa khat bangin amah mawlpih-in, na nasem numeite aa dingin khaukhihsak ding na hi hiam?

Ngapi-tei tawh ama vun khawhlet zo ding na hi hiam? Nnga khawhna teipi tawh a lutang sunlet zo ding na hi hiam?
Ama tungah khut khial ding na hih leh, a haksatna na phawk ding a, cik mahin na hih nawn kei ding hi!

Ama guh leh tang, a thahatna leh a vanglian ama pum pianzia thu ah dai takin ka om kei ding hi.
Kua in ama puan tungnung hawkkhiatsak zo ding ahi hiam? Kua in kamkaih bulh dingin neh zo ding ahi hiam?
A kigual diudeu a kihtakhuai ama hate, a maitang kongkhakte kua in hong ngam ding ahi hiam?
A nungzanga a lipte, a gualguala kithuap lumte tawh kibang a, kip takin a kituah khawm hi.
A kikal ah huih nangawn a lut zo lo phial dingin khat le khat a kineh tinten hi.
Tuate khat le khat kizom a, tuate khat le khat kimat bikbekin, a kikhenkhia thei kei hi.
A hetcheina in khuavak thehkhia ziahziah a, ama mittangte zingsang mitvunte tawh kibang hi.

Sawl kuang tunga kisuang beel sunga tuiso bangin a nak panin meikhu a suakkhia hi.
A husanna in meihol tawhkuang a, a kam panin meikuangpi a leengkhia hi.

Amah a dintoh ciangin, a thahatte lausak a, ama khesik ging hangin amaute a kihem uh hi.
Namsau tawh a kisat hangin bangmah ci lo a, teipi, teikhawh leh tulzum in zong a bun zo kei hi.
